LspPosition.description:
A position in a document: a zero-based line, and a zero-based column in
the position encoding the client and server agreed on.

character.description: The column, from 0, in the negotiated position encoding.

LspRange.description: A range in a document, from `start` up to (not including) `end`.

range.description: The range to replace, in the document as it is before the edit.

changes.description: The edits to each document, by its URI.

anyOf.description: The edit that performs the action.

edit.description:
Plain text edits under `changes`, in canonical form: to the
requested document, and, for an action on the content model, to
`ascribe.toml` and any other pages it changes.

select.description:
The placeholder text the edit wrote, in the document as it is
after the edit, for the client to leave selected; `null` when it
wrote none.

anyOf.description:
Why the action can't be performed: the document changed under it, it
doesn't apply where it was invoked, or an argument is invalid. A
plain-language sentence, for the client to show.

description: The answer to `ascribe/edit`: the edit, or why there is none.
title: EditResult
